instruction: Look at freecad_task-11_input.step in FreeCAD. On this machine, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-11_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Keep the 70 x 60 x 8 mm rectangular plate unchanged. Create one vertical through hole of diameter 18 mm at center (50,30). Create two additional vertical through holes of diameter 8 mm at centers (20,20) and (20,40). Export the final three-hole plate as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-11_output.step.
